name: Progress M-33
about: Progress M-33 (1996-066A), a crewed vehicle (Progress M), launched 1996 Nov 19. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1996 Dec 21), held fixed
docked to S17845; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
